sentences.text: Biscuit, a 9-year-old spayed Beagle, had soft or loose stool on 8 of 26 logged days between May 4 and May 31, and blood was described once, on May 18; this record cannot rule blood out on other days.
A metronidazole course, 250 mg twice daily from May 20 to 26, overlaps that window, with 13 of 14 doses logged as given.
Her owner-entered diet, Purina EN Gastroenteric, is unchanged in this window, with at least 2 off-list feedings logged: cheese on May 9 and rawhide on May 23.
Stool on the 5 of 31 days with no entries is unknown.
